Name: Rasmodia Portraits for Romanceable Rasmodius-RRRR
Author: CookieMaster05
Description:
I altered the Female Wizard from Ohodavi's anime Portraits to match the romance expansion from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿ by Jellonip.

So now you can play with the huge romance expansion RRRR and have the female witch Rasmodia with matching portraits including beach sprites.
You can use the normal beach sprites or the skimpy beach version. Each version has 32 portraits to match with RRRR.

I've also included the Beach portraits in a separate file.


﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1) These portraits are intended to be used with the following mods and their dependencies:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999] ﻿Portraiture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265] ﻿Romanceable Rasmodia - Female Wizard[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893] ﻿RRRR[/url]﻿
2) Extract only one Wizard.png into a folder of your choice here [i]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits [/i]

3) Run SDV with SMAPI and when talking with Rasmodia ingame press "P" to change to the Portraits.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]
